title: Run-state read denied during a concurrent atomic replace (read side of FAIL-0005)
summary: The ORCH-0035 full-suite gate raised PermissionError [Errno 13] in tests/test_orchestrator_roadmap.py::test_continue_returns_immediately_and_reports_each_step: engine.status -> store.load -> storage.load_json opened state.json while the driver thread was os.replace-ing it. On Windows an open for read can be denied during a replace. FAIL-0005 added retries to the write side only; this is the matching read side. The change under test (GUI view) did not touch engine, store or storage. Fix: storage.load_json retries PermissionError up to 5 times with 50 ms exponential backoff and re-raises on the last attempt.
